verdict.rationale: AMD's own GAIA agent framework (built for Ryzen AI hardware) explicitly advertises 'MCP Integration — Connect to any MCP server for external tool access' and includes a client-side tool registry/MCP client interface, showing the ecosystem around this CPU supports plugging in MCP servers. However this capability lives in a separate first-party software project rather than being a built-in chip feature, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of MCP server usage in practice. Missing for 10: independent verification of MCP tool-use working end-to-end, and clearer integration between the CPU's marketed AI features and the GAIA MCP client.
